states: Alerts overview Proxmox storage alerts link to /proxmox/storage?resource=<storage id>; ZFS pool-state and device alerts link to their storage (storageResourceId), never the composite zfs-pool id
Storage opened from a pool alert expands that pool and highlights its row; its inline detail (capacity trend) is in view at 1280 and 375 wide, no horizontal overflow at 375
An alert source id the records do not carry (mock-cluster-1-pve1-local) resolves through one registry lookup and opens its pool
An unresolved ?resource= on Storage makes exactly one registry request and opens nothing
Storage mounted behind the Overview tab ignores a guest ?resource= link; only the workloads table looks it up
interactions: Clicked a ZFS device alert name and a pool alert name on Alerts overview, landing on Storage with the pool open
Opened another pool by hand, followed an unresolved storage link (operator pool stayed open), then followed the first pool link again (it reopened)
Followed a guest link on the Overview tab, then a storage link, and the linked pool opened
Repeated the alert-to-Storage click at 375x812 and 1280x800
